description: This file defines an abstract class GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner in the Orleans.Transactions.TestKit namespace. It provides various asynchronous test methods for transaction scenarios involving grains, such as read and write operations, multi-grain transactions, repeated transactions, and different concurrency patterns. The class relies on external grain interfaces like ITransactionTestGrain and ITransactionCoordinatorGrain, and uses FluentAssertions for assertions.

classes.name: GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a framework for running various transaction test scenarios involving grains in Orleans.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read transaction on a single grain, checking that all retrieved values are initially zero.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a single grain by adding a delta to its values and verifying the update.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction across multiple grains, adding a specified value and verifying each grain's values.

methods.name: MultiGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read-write transaction on multiple grains involving set and double operations, verifying expected values.

methods.name: RepeatGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Repeatedly performs read-write transactions on grains, verifying incremental expected values over iterations.

methods.name: MultiWriteToSingleGrainTransaction
methods.description: Performs multiple concurrent writes to a single grain and verifies the aggregated result.

methods.name: RWRWTest
methods.description: Performs a read-write-read-write pattern of operations across grains, verifying final values.

methods.name: WRWRTest
methods.description: Performs a write-read-write-read pattern of operations across grains, verifying the final values.
